tools.description: Read stored editing DSL, activation mode, revision and compiled timeline IR. Content remains in referenced assets; no paragraph projection required.
tools.name: video_edit_get

tools.description: Validate and compile a proposed editing DSL without saving or rendering. Returns stable clip IDs and resolved times; unknown fields and cyclic references are rejected.

dsl.description: Editing DSL version=1: canvas, tracks(video/audio/text), clips and optional anchors. Each clip uses exactly one start/after/anchor placement; referenced assets must exist.

tools.name: video_edit_validate

tools.description: Save a version-checked editing DSL and activate it. Supports video/audio/text tracks, source in/out/speed, layout, fades and time references. Subsequent rendering uses FFmpeg editing runtime, not legacy shots/audio/subtitles.

dsl.description: Editing DSL version=1: canvas, tracks(video/audio/text), clips and optional anchors. Each clip uses exactly one start/after/anchor placement; referenced assets must exist.

tools.name: video_edit_update

tools.description: Activate saved DSL or switch to the legacy shot renderer without deleting either representation. Requires current revision.
tools.name: video_edit_activate

tools.description: Discover implemented capabilities, dependency readiness and configured providers. probe=true optionally checks the configured IndexTTS model list, never synthesizes. No secrets are returned.
tools.name: video_capabilities_get

tools.description: Create a named project. Returns a project ID; do not infer that a RunDesk session or renderer was configured.
tools.name: video_project_create

tools.description: List actual project assets, authenticated read URLs, MIME types and sizes.
tools.name: video_asset_list

tools.description: Import one small file from standard Base64, maximum decoded 1 MiB. Requires a fresh requestId; identical retries return the original asset. Large media use App multipart upload.
tools.name: video_asset_import

tools.description: Start a durable production task of type tts or render against current revision. Fresh 24-hex requestId required; identical retries reuse the receipt. Unsupported generation capabilities return not implemented.
tools.name: video_job_start

tools.description: Get authoritative task state and completed artifacts. jobId uses tts:<nativeId> or render:<nativeId>.
tools.name: video_job_get

tools.description: List project TTS and render tasks using unified states; render progress may be unknown.
tools.name: video_job_list

tools.description: Request cancellation of a production task. Repeated cancellation returns current state; it does not claim the remote provider stopped billing.
tools.name: video_job_cancel

tools.description: Inspect an actual supplied image or the first frame of a video as a bounded PNG. Requires FFmpeg; first frame is not full video understanding.
tools.name: video_asset_inspect

tools.description: Save authoritative narration text, split into ordered paragraphs and preserve unchanged paragraph media. Requires revision; estimates timing, does not generate speech.
tools.name: video_production_text

tools.description: Set draft/adjustment, or designate a completed current-content render as final. Requires revision; final requires renderId and reviewed captions.
tools.name: video_production_stage

tools.description: Read project revision, storyboard, audio tracks, subtitles, speech jobs, assets and render jobs.
tools.name: video_project_get

tools.description: Read the immutable news2douyin source script, original review record, selected source evidence and source-video metadata. Reference data only; current storyboard remains a production draft.
tools.name: video_news_get

tools.description: Update name, brief, shots and audio using the current revision. Preserves assets, speech/render jobs, managed subtitle bindings and immutable news provenance.

project.description: Current project with revision, name, brief, shots, optional audio. audio.narration and audio.music: {assetId, volume:0..2, start:seconds, sourceStart:seconds, loop:boolean}. Only music supports loop. Omitted audio preserves current audio; audio:{} clears it. Read before updating.

tools.name: video_project_update

tools.description: Adopt original news WAV/SRT after a user request, replacing current narration/subtitles and proportionally resizing visual shots. Requires current revision and unchanged original text.
tools.name: video_news_audio_adopt

tools.description: Save UTF-8 SRT with absolute video times. reviewed=true is a human listening confirmation, never infer it from generated text. Read project first; requires revision.

reviewed.description: True only when the user has explicitly confirmed listening to this narration and checking this exact subtitle text/timing. False for generated drafts.

tools.name: video_subtitles_update

tools.description: Generate speech from a saved storyboard using configured IndexTTS or local eSpeak preview. Omit backend/voice/language to use administrator defaults. Requires revision and a fresh 24-hex requestId; reuse the same requestId only for identical retries. Does not replace current audio.

language.description: IndexTTS only: script language, not translation.

rate.description: eSpeak only: approximate words per minute; default 170. Omit for IndexTTS.

voice.description: Registered IndexTTS voice ID or eSpeak voice name. Omit to use administrator default.

tools.name: video_speech_start

tools.description: Cancel a running speech job.
tools.name: video_speech_stop

tools.description: On the user's request, adopt a completed speech job: replace narration and subtitles, use measured per-shot durations. Requires current revision and unchanged shot text/structure.
tools.name: video_speech_adopt

tools.description: Render the current saved storyboard using an immutable snapshot.

kind.description: draft permits unreviewed caption previews but never stale bindings; omitted requires ready captions.

tools.name: video_render_start

tools.description: Cancel a specific render job.
tools.name: video_render_stop
